transcript.en: It's really good to see you, Tom. Since I had to give up work, I feel I'm losing touch with my friends and colleagues.
transcript.zh: 真高兴见到你，汤姆。自从我不得不放弃工作以来，感觉和朋友、同事之间的联系越来越少了。

transcript.en: We really miss you in the office – we were all so sorry you had to leave. But you must be relieved to have more time to look after your mother. How is she?
transcript.zh: 我们都特别怀念你在办公室的日子——大家对你离开都挺遗憾的。不过你现在有更多时间照顾你妈妈，应该也宽慰一些了吧？她最近怎么样？

transcript.en: Well, she's very cheerful but she needs a lot of help.
transcript.zh: 嗯，她挺乐观的，但确实需要很多照顾。

transcript.en: Have you tried to get any support from the local council?
transcript.zh: 你有没有试着向当地相关部门申请一些帮助？

transcript.en: No. I didn't know I could.
transcript.zh: 没有，我还真不知道可以这么做。

transcript.en: Yes, they offer different kinds of practical support.
transcript.zh: 其实他们提供很多实在的帮助。

transcript.en: They realise that carers sometimes need time for all the other responsibilities they have apart from the person they're caring for, and also that they sometimes need a break.
transcript.zh: 因为他们知道，照顾别人的同时，看护者本人也需要空出时间处理自己的事情，而且他们也需要时不时休息一下。

transcript.en: Absolutely. OK, so tell me more. How do I go about getting this support?
transcript.zh: 说得对。详细说说吧。我要怎么做才能得到这些帮助？

transcript.en: Well, you'd have to have an assessment of your mother's needs.
transcript.zh: 首先，你需要为你母亲的生活需求做一个评估。

transcript.en: That means someone would come round and talk to you about the situation and what you need.
transcript.zh: 就是说，会有人上门了解你们的情况，看看你需要哪些帮助。

transcript.en: So for a start they'd want to know the amount of time you spend looking after your mother every day.
transcript.zh: 他们会先了解你每天花多少时间照顾你母亲。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Then they'll probably ask you what sorts of tasks you do for your mother during the day. Things like if she needs help with getting dressed, for example.
transcript.zh: 然后他们可能还会问你平时都帮你妈妈做些什么，比如她是否需要人帮忙穿衣服之类的。

transcript.en: Right. I help her with that, and also I help her get into the shower in the morning.
transcript.zh: 是的，我每天都要帮她穿衣，早上还要帮她冲凉。

transcript.en: Yes, that sort of thing. They'll probably ask you if you do the shopping for her, and help her at mealtimes. And whether she can cope using money.
transcript.zh: 对，就是这些方面。他们可能还会问你是否帮她买东西、进餐时帮助她，还有她会不会自己管理钱。

transcript.en: Yes, that's becoming a bit of a problem. She used to be very good at it, but not any more.
transcript.zh: 是啊，这个问题最近开始出现了。以前她挺会管钱的，现在就不行了。

transcript.en: And be ready to tell them about anything you find particularly difficult about caring for your mother.
transcript.zh: 另外，你要准备好把照顾过程中遇到的各种困难告诉他们。

transcript.en: So recently I've noticed she's started to have quite bad problems with her memory ... if I wasn't there, I think she'd forget to eat, for example.
transcript.zh: 最近我注意到她的记忆力明显变差了……比如说，如果我不在身边，她可能会忘记吃饭。

transcript.en: And often she doesn't seem quite sure what day it is.
transcript.zh: 而且她常常搞不清今天星期几。

transcript.en: Yes, tell them about that. And are there any physical difficulties you have caring for her? Lifting her, for example?
transcript.zh: 这些情况也要告诉他们。你在照顾她的过程中，有没有遇到体力上的困难？比如移动她的时候？

transcript.en: Yes. She's quite heavy, and I'm afraid of hurting my back – I'd be in real trouble if that happened.
transcript.zh: 有的。我妈很重，我担心我会伤到腰——要是伤到了，我就麻烦了。

transcript.en: They can give you advice about that, and also about how to avoid the possibility of your mum having a fall.
transcript.zh: 他们会给你一些建议，教你怎么避免你妈妈摔倒的风险。

transcript.en: Great. So once they've done this assessment, if I'm eligible, what happens next?
transcript.zh: 太好了。那等他们做完评估以后，如果我能符合条件，接下来会有什么安排？

transcript.en: Well, they might support you financially. So they might help you with transport costs, like if you have to get a taxi to take your mother for an appointment, for example.
transcript.zh: 他们会考虑对你提供经济支持。比如如果你要打车带你妈妈去看病，这部分交通费用他们可能会帮你承担。

transcript.en: I usually drive her myself actually. So could I claim for the petrol?
transcript.zh: 我一般自己开车送她。那我可以报销汽油费吗？

transcript.en: You could, and you can claim for the insurance too.
transcript.zh: 可以，连车险之类的费用也可以一起申请报销。

transcript.en: Oh, right.
transcript.zh: 明白了。

transcript.en: And if you need help with the housework, they can arrange for someone to come along once or twice a week.
transcript.zh: 如果你需要家政服务，他们还可以安排每周一两次有人来打扫或做饭。

transcript.en: And one other thing, I hope you don't mind me saying this, but it's important you look after yourself, and it seems to me you're under quite a bit of stress.
transcript.zh: 顺便说一句，希望你不介意我说这个，但你自己也要注意休息，我看你现在压力挺大的。

transcript.en: I am, yes.
transcript.zh: 是的，我现在确实挺累的。

transcript.en: Well, tell the council, because they may be able to give you some advice on how to minimise it.
transcript.zh: 那你一定要跟有关部门说明情况，他们也会给一些缓解压力的建议。

transcript.en: Really? Though actually I feel so much better having talked to you. I'll get in touch with the council straight away. Now shall we ...
transcript.zh: 真的吗？不过说实话，跟你聊完我感觉轻松多了。我打算立刻联系有关部门。那我们现在……
